program_binary.context_slot_correction: Corrected the research metadata slot 456615818 to 456615846 by decoding the preserved raw response; payload and raw response SHA pins match.
program_binary.relationship_check: PASS: canonical program account is executable and owned by UpgradeableLoader; its variant-2 data points to the queried variant-3 ProgramData account, also owned by UpgradeableLoader; ProgramData payload at offset 45 starts with ELF magic and identifies as eBPF SBF.

fulfill_builder_protocol: Fetch client account and pending request by client plus 32-byte seed.
Construct message = client public-key bytes concatenated with seed bytes (64 bytes).
Create a Solana Ed25519Program instruction using fulfillAuthority public key, message, and 64-byte Ed25519 signature.
Prepend that Ed25519 instruction to the ORAO fulfill instruction; pass SYSVAR_INSTRUCTIONS_PUBKEY as instruction_acc.
The ORAO program reads the sysvar instruction and checks authority/config plus signature-to-seed; fulfill params are empty.
A normal callback is optional; noCallback leaves no callback CPI, while request-level callback can override client-level callback.
